key_risks: Further downside surprises in July CPI or FOMC minutes could delay rate-cut expectations and pressure cyclicals
Earnings disappointments from regional banks or industrial names scheduled in mid-July could trigger sector rotation
OPEC+ supply increase may keep energy prices soft, indirectly weighing on broader risk appetite

portfolio.rationale: Weak June payrolls and downward revisions increase odds of near-term Fed easing, which historically supports domestic small-cap outperformance over the next month.
Financials posted the strongest 30-day return among major sectors and stand to benefit from any steepening yield curve or improved credit conditions following soft labor data.
Industrials showed solid 30-day gains and are positioned for domestic growth sensitivity amid potential policy support before the August 6 exit.
Aerospace and defense delivered the second-highest 30-day sector return and offers defensive growth exposure with limited direct sensitivity to the softening labor print.

portfolio_rationale: Soft labor data and contained inflation raise the probability of supportive policy moves within the scoring window, favoring cyclical and rate-sensitive domestic equity factors over broad market or defensive allocations.
rationale_summary: Concentrated 25% weights in four sectors with recent strength and direct exposure to potential Fed easing and domestic growth catalysts before the August 6 close.
